verdict.rationale: A probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404), but a markdown rendering of the docs is served at /docs.md (HTTP 200), which gives an agent a machine-readable entry point. That falls short of a dedicated llms.txt or explicitly agent-oriented documentation. The MCP server claims are about serving tools, not agent-readable docs, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, first-party documentation describing agent-oriented or markdown docs access, per-page markdown coverage beyond the getting-started page, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the docs.
